significance: A mud volcano in Hingol National Park venerated by Hindus as an embodiment of Shiva under the name Baba Chandrakup, and a station of the four-day Hinglaj Yatra held each April alongside the nearby Hinglaj Mata Temple.
story: Pilgrims hold that the Hinglaj Mata temple may be entered only after homage has first been paid to Baba Chandrakup.
